settings.heading: A small 3D-printing studio in Lebanon.
settings.text: We draw every shape ourselves and print it layer by layer, 0.2 mm at a time, then check and pack each piece by hand. The fine lines are part of the texture.

settings.title: Ribs
settings.text: Soft ribs all the way round, on every piece. They catch the light and hide the print lines.

settings.question: Do you deliver everywhere in Lebanon?
settings.answer: Yes. Delivery takes 2 to 4 days and costs $5, free on orders from $35.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: In cash when your order arrives. You don't need an account to order.

settings.question: Do the lids screw on?
settings.answer: Yes. Every lid screws on in about two turns, so it stays shut in a bag and doesn’t wear out like a click lid.

settings.question: Is the Tuck Travel Box watertight?
settings.answer: Not fully. The lid keeps the soap in, but let a wet bar drip for a minute before you close it.

settings.question: Which toothbrush fits the Shuttle?
settings.answer: A manual toothbrush up to about 20 cm long and 2.4 cm wide. Electric toothbrushes don’t fit.

settings.question: What if something arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Send us a photo by Instagram DM within 48 hours of delivery and we print you a new one, free. No need to send the broken piece back.

settings.heading: Rather order by message?
settings.text: Send us a DM on Instagram with the piece and colour, and we take it from there.
